title: Effects of fluorinated ski wax bans on per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS) concentrations in indoor dust from ski waxing workspaces
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1632-1641
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00024J, Paper
Kathyrn A. Crawford, Nicola Hartmann, Emilia Andersen, Celeste Alden, Divya Gudur, Bharat Chandramouli
Consumer products such as ski and snowboard wax can contain high concentrations of PFAS and be a source of exposure among consumers.
